articles.title: Driver wanted after striking motorcyclist in North York
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for the driver of a vehicle that allegedly struck a motorcyclist and then fled the scene in North York. The collision happened around 6:45 p.m. on July 15 in the area of Carnforth Road and Lawrence Avenue East. It’s alleged that a 17-year-old boy was driving a motorcycle southbound on Carnforth […]

articles.title: Allan Gardens could get a major greenhouse expansion if the city puts in $10M: councillor
articles.summary: A Toronto councillor and volunteer-based community organization are calling on the city to put $9 million more toward expanding the Allan Gardens greenhouse complex.

articles.title: Mississauga councillor wants pause on AI data centres as Toronto councillors grapple with proposed facilities
articles.summary: Critics of AI data centres have expressed concerns over high power and water consumption along with noise issues.

articles.title: Man, 78, wanted for allegedly assaulting person in Leslieville
articles.summary: A 78-year-old man is wanted for allegedly assaulting a person in Leslieville Monday. Toronto police were called to the Queen Street East and Pape Avenue around 9 a.m. for reports of an assault. It’s alleged officers found a victim on the scene with injuries. They were taken to hospital with serious, non-life-threatening injuries. Jian Liu, […]

articles.title: Canada-wide warrant issued for Brampton man accused of attempted murder in double shooting
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police have issued a Canada-wide arrest warrant for a Brampton man in connection to a double shooting in April. Kaleb Kimotho, 19, is wanted on several charges including attempted murder using a firearm, aggravated assault and discharge a firearm with intent. Investigators say on April 26 two people were sitting in a vehicle […]

articles.title: Ontario rethinking support for high-speed rail after feds reject Billy Bishop expansion: source
articles.summary: The federal government's rejection of a plan to allow commercial jets at Toronto's Billy Bishop Airport is threatening a wedge between the Ford government and Ottawa — and potentially strengthening opposition to a major high-speed rail project.

articles.title: Child critically injured after reported drowning in Mississauga
articles.summary: A child has been critically injured after police were called to a home in Mississauga for a reported drowning. Emergency responders were called to the residence near Fifth Line West and Dundas Street West around 11:30 a.m. on Tuesday. Paramedics transported the child to hospital with life-threatening injuries. There’s no futher details at this time.

articles.title: Child in critical condition after being pulled from Mississauga pool
articles.summary: A child has been pulled from a pool at a Mississauga home and rushed to hospital in life-threatening condition, Peel police say.

articles.title: Patrick Brown seeking 3rd term as Brampton mayor
articles.summary: Brown, who was first elected in 2018, says he is running to see through "transformational" transit and infrastructure projects, and he will continue to focus on public safety.

articles.title: Police searching for left-handed shooter in 2022 Scarborough slaying
articles.summary: Over three years after Toronto man Ding Ping Wang was shot and killed inside a car in a Scarborough industrial plaza parking lot, investigators are releasing new information in the hopes that someone can help them track down his killer.

articles.title: Etobicoke waste transfer station has 2nd major fire in under a year
articles.summary: An industrial fire broke out shortly before 4 a.m. Tuesday near Disco Road and Highway 427, emergency responders say. The fire is now under control, according to Toronto Fire, but crews are expected to be on the scene all day.

articles.title: Toronto mayor files urgent motion demanding province 'return our waterfront' after feds reject airport plans
articles.summary: Toronto’s mayor says she filed an urgent motion Monday to demand the province give back waterfront land after the federal government rejected a proposal for a jet expansion at Billy Bishop Airport.

articles.title: Durham deputy chief retires after misconduct finding over 'racially inappropriate term'
articles.summary: A deputy chief with the Durham Regional Police Service is retiring after an investigation found he committed misconduct, the police board says.

articles.title: U.S. Consulate fired upon for 2nd time this year, police seek suspect vehicle
articles.summary: Police say the U.S. Consulate in Toronto, which was shot at in March, was again the target of gunfire Monday morning. Investigators say they pursued a suspect vehicle to the Don Valley Parkway immediately after the shooting, but called off the chase when it reached dangerous speeds.
